pgroups.description: List of procedure groups with build configuration.

libs.description: List of libraries to include during compilation.

pli-options.description: Macro definitions which will be passed to the PL/I compiler.

include-extensions.description: List of file extensions to treat as include files.

implicit-builtins.description: List of builtins to include implicitly.

member-name-validation.description: Whether to enable member name validation for this procedure group.

lsp-options.description: Options for the Language Server Protocol.

check-margins.description: Whether to check for margins in the PL/I code.

instruction-counter-limit.description: Maximum number of times to run an instructions during preprocessing. The default is 5000.

case-upper-validation.description: Whether to validate the CASE(UPPER) macro option and provide diagnostics for quickfixes.
